rules.statement: A deed of gift can create a valid fidei commissum even without an express deed from the donee, provided the language indicates such intention.
rules.supporting_quote: "As to the contention that the fidei commissum did not become effective by reason of the absence of a deed of gift in favor of Bandara Menika and Muttu Menika, I think the answer is that if a valid fidei commissum has in point of fact been created then the fidei commissary became vested with the property immediately the fidei commissum matured by the happening of the contingency fie death of the donor."
